name: Media Tagging Manager Jellyfin Plugin
description: Enriches selected Jellyfin media with provider, network, genre, people, relationship, production, ratings, and language metadata.
overview: Stable metadata enrichment for selected Jellyfin libraries.

versions.changelog: Preserves pre-existing, NFO-imported, and other-tool-created tags by removing only exact per-item tags recorded as added by this plugin.
